page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c4.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB physical cores operating at 3.2 GHz with 1 thread per core. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data shows average performance across standard compute tasks. The instance achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1575.79 and a multi-core score of 8310.78. Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read bandwidth is average at 464.83 GB/sec, uncached large-block read bandwidth drops to a weak 37.74 GB/sec. Passmark memory and database operations scores also fall into the bottom 25% tier. For specialized workloads, the CPU supports AVX-512 and vector neural network instructions (VNNI), enabling average performance in lightweight LLM inference but poor performance for larger models like the 7B parameter model.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, this instance offers a compute-focused resource density. The lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage attachment, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. The instance is suited for compute-bound workloads with low memory footprints, such as static web serving, software compilation, and lightweight text or image processing, whereas memory-intensive databases or large-scale AI inference are constrained by the memory bandwidth and capacity.
